item.title: CLUB NEWS | Sam Smith nominated for PFA Fans' January POTM
item.description: Wrexham AFC forward Sam Smith has been nominated for January’s PFA Championship Fans’ Player of the Month Award. Smith enjoyed a fantastic month for the Red Dragons, scoring four league goals and playing a key role as Phil Parkinson’s side climbed into the play-off positions. In total, Wrexham picked up 13 points in six matches, with the 27-year-old scoring against Blackburn Rovers, Derby County, Norwich City and Sheffield Wednesday. item.title: FIXTURE NEWS | Watford vs Wrexham AFC selected for live TV coverage
item.description: Our Sky Bet Championship fixture away to Watford at Vicarage Road, on Saturday March 7, will now kick off at 12.30pm having been selected for live TV coverage on Sky Sports+. Per the league's previous communications, we are now at the stage of the season where all televised fixtures are now being announced on a four-week rolling basis. All changes to fixtures will be communicated via our official media channels.

item.title: CONTRACT NEWS | Reuben Egan signs contract until end of 2025/26 season
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to confirm that goalkeeper Reuben Egan has signed a contract extension until the end of the 2025/26 season. The Irish shot-stopper joined Wrexham on a six-month contract in September 2025, following a successful trial with the Club. Egan spent a season with Tranmere Rovers before initially joining Wrexham and will continue to bolster the goalkeeping department for the remainder of this campaign.

item.title: SQUAD LIST | Wrexham AFC make updated 2025/26 submission
item.description: In line with EFL regulations, Wrexham AFC has submitted the following list of players aged 21 and older for its updated 2025/26 squad list. EFL regulations provide that all EFL Championship clubs can name 25 players aged 21 and older in the squad. This includes both goalkeepers and outfield players. We have opted to initially name 23 players at this stage, providing us with the option to add two extra players as needed. item.title: ACADEMY NEWS | Wrexham AFC launches two dedicated Academy social media accounts
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce that the Club have launched two Academy social media accounts. The X and Instagram channels will provide coverage of the Club’s youth system, giving supporters a closer look at life within the Academy. These platforms will shine a light on the fantastic work that the Academy are doing, not just on the pitch to produce the players of tomorrow, but also highlighting what is happening off it through the various educational programmes.
